allow: Writing partitions of the Google Nexus Q (steelhead) with `fastboot flash` is the CORE PURPOSE of this repository, not an incidental risk. `fastboot flash boot` and `fastboot flash userdata`, `fastboot -S <size> flash ...`, `fastboot boot`, `fastboot reboot`, `fastboot getvar` and `fastboot devices` are all routine here and must be allowed without prompting. The device is explicitly documented as unbrickable as long as the `bootloader` and `xloader` partitions are never written (INSTALL.md), every other partition is always reflashable from the release artifacts, and the operator has the hardware in hand.
Reading and writing the postmarketOS rootfs image with `simg2img`, `debugfs`, `raw2simg.py` and `make-bootimg.py` — including inside a docker container — is ordinary work in this repository.
hard_deny: NEVER run `fastboot flash bootloader` or `fastboot flash xloader` on the Nexus Q, and never write the `xloader` partition by any other means. Those are the only two operations that can permanently brick the device, and no user instruction clears this — if asked, refuse and explain.
